name: Backup, Speed Optimizer & Database Cleaner: Fast Restore, Site Migration and Site Speed
author: Jet Vault Dev

sections.description:
Backup & Speed Optimizer is the ultimate solution for protecting and accelerating your WordPress site. It combines a powerful backup system with professional-grade database maintenance tools to keep your site running at peak performance.

Key Features:
* One-Click WordPress Backup: Create complete backups of your database and files with a single click.
* Instant Restore & Recovery: Roll back your site to a previous state in seconds if anything goes wrong.
* Professional Database Cleanup: Remove post revisions, auto-drafts, spam comments, and transient data to reduce database size.
* Database Table Optimization: Defragment and optimize database tables for faster SQL queries.
* Automated Scheduled Maintenance: Schedule backups and cleanups to run automatically at your preferred intervals.
* Detailed Activity Logs: Monitor every optimization and backup process with clear activity logs.

Why Choose This WordPress Backup & Speed Tool?

Keeping your website fast and secure is crucial for SEO and user experience. This plugin offers a lightweight yet powerful way to manage your site’s health without slowing down your admin dashboard. Whether you need a quick WordPress database cleanup or a reliable backup and restore solution, we’ve got you covered.

Advanced Database Optimization & Cleanup

Over time, your WordPress database accumulates unnecessary data that slows down your site. Our database optimizer helps you:
* Clean up orphaned metadata and old revisions.
* Optimize database tables for better performance.
* Improve page load times by reducing database overhead.
* Keep your site lean and fast for better search engine rankings.

Automated Backups for Total Peace of Mind

Don’t wait for a site crash to realize you need a backup. With our automated backup feature, you can schedule regular backups of your entire site. If an update breaks your site or you face a security issue, use our one-click restore to get back online instantly. It’s the most reliable way to ensure your data is always safe.

Secure Your WordPress Site & Boost Performance

A fast site is a secure site. By regularly performing a database optimization and maintaining current WordPress backups, you protect your business from data loss and improve your SEO rankings. Our plugin is designed to be the only tool you need for complete site maintenance, focusing on both speed and security.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the jetvault-backup-optimizer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in your admin dashboard.
  3. Access the settings via the ‘Jetvault’ menu in your admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, all core features are free and ready to use.

Where are my backups stored?

Backups are stored securely in your wp-content/uploads/jetvault-backups/ directory.
